library_subtitle_signed_out: Sign in and book a seat
library_no_bookings_body: Pick a library and book in a few steps.
library_verify_email_body: Verify your institutional email to view and book library seats.
library_session_expired: Your library link has expired: verify your email again.
library_unlink_body: This browser will stop showing your library bookings until you verify your email again. Your bookings stay valid.
library_no_libraries_body: There are no libraries to book a seat in at the moment.
library_forecast_caption: Forecast by time slot, as a share of capacity.
library_forecast_empty: No forecast for the rest of the day.
library_not_found_body: The link may be old: pick the library from the list.
library_no_zones_body: This library has no bookable zones at the moment.
library_no_bookable_days: No bookable days for this zone.
library_times_loading_failed: Unable to load the free time slots.
library_no_available_times: No free time slots on this day.
library_no_available_times_body: Try another day or a shorter duration.
library_no_free_seats_body: No seats are available at this time: try a different time or duration.
library_note_required: Fill in this field to book.
library_book_confirm_body: {library}, {when}. If you change your mind, you can cancel the booking from your bookings.
library_retry_soon: Try again shortly: if it keeps failing, pick another time.
library_booked_body: You’ll find it in your bookings. At the library, check in from 10 minutes before the start.
library_offline_write: You’re offline: you can book or cancel once you’re back online.
library_will_send_link: We’ll send an access link to your institutional email to sync your bookings.
library_no_password: Affluences, the libraries’ booking service, verifies your address with a link: no password needed.
library_link_sent: We’ve sent you a link. Open it on any device: this page notices on its own.
library_waiting: Waiting for you to open the link…
library_polling_paused: Automatic check paused. Once you’ve opened the link, tap “I’ve opened the link”.
library_open_link_again: Open it from your institutional email, then try again.
library_check_spam: Can’t find it? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
library_reservation_not_found_body: It may have been cancelled or already ended.
library_verification_opens: Check-in opens {when}, {minutes} minutes before the start.
library_qr_or_code: Scan the library QR code or enter the code it shows.
library_check_in_description: Enter the validation code shown in the library.
library_invalid_code: Invalid code: check the QR or the code and try again.
library_cancel_body: If you no longer need it, free the seat for other students.
library_cancel_unavailable: This booking can’t be cancelled from the app.
library_confirm_cancel: You’re about to cancel seat {seat} in {library}, {when}. It will become available to other students.
library_cancelled_body: The seat is available to other students again.
library_cancel_link_invalid_body: The booking may already have been cancelled.
library_cancel_link_not_cancellable: This booking can no longer be cancelled.
library_cancel_link_failed: Couldn’t read the booking in the link
library_code_only: Enter the validation code shown at the library.
library_checked_in_body: Attendance for this booking is already recorded.
library_seat_taken_body: Someone else booked it: pick another seat for the same time.
library_seat_missing_body: The link may be old: pick the seat from the list.
library_slot_gone: This time can no longer be booked.
library_slot_gone_body: Pick the day and time again.
library_cancel_link_paste_body: In the Affluences email, copy the link that cancels the booking and paste it here: you’ll see which booking it cancels before confirming.
library_cancel_link_unreadable: This link doesn’t contain a booking to cancel.
library_awaiting_body: Affluences emailed you to confirm this booking: open the link to keep it.
